Name: Seasonal Baechu (Bachelors and Bachelorettes)
Author: comfemshep
Description:
[b]NOW COMPATIBLE WITH STARDEW 1.6
[/b](Please inform me if this isn't true for your game!)

[b]MORE THAN JUST THE BACHELORETTES/BACHELORS NOW!!![/b]




I absolutely adore both Baechu's portraits, AkiraE's changes to make them seasonal and Poltergeist's Seasonal Cute Characters and I finally, finally got around to making them all compatible with each other and my own Sprite Edits!!

All the credit goes to Baechu, AkiraE and Poltergeist.

I edited the portraits and sprites (some a lot, some barely) to fit together.
The code is basically all Frankenstein'd from Poltergeister's mod.


[b][u]Installation:[/u][/b]

1. Make sure you have [b]SMAPI [/b]installed.
2. Make sure you have [b]Content Patcher[/b] in your mods folder.
3. Download this mod and unzip it.
4. Drag the unzipped folder into your mods folder-
[i]Done! The portraits and sprites should now show in your game.


[/i][b][u]Compatibility with Seasonal Cute Outfits:[/u][/b][i]
Both mods let you choose which character to activate it for so simply disable all characters in one mod that you want to use from the other mod and vice versa.[/i]


[b][u]*Change Log*[/u][/b]
1.1 The two files were conflicting and the portraits weren't showing the correct expressions so I merged them into one file.
2.0 Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6! Also, Abigail shows up properly during Festivals now.
2.1 Fixed the issue where characters would display as vanilla during winter (at the cost of losing the winter Indoor/Outdoor variation)
      The former Outdoor variants of their appearances are now their Ice Festival appearances
      Seven of the bachelors/bachelorettes have new appearances for the Luau. I'll be adding the rest soon.
3.0 Caroline, Jodi, Marnie, Sandy, Demetrius, Kent, Pam, Vincent, Gus, Lewis, Linus, Pierre, Wizard, Jas, Linus, Robin, Mr Qi have seasonal and Ice Festival                   Outfits!!! :D
4.0 Added proper 1.6 Compatibility, you can now set which characters to apply changes to in the config file



I am thrilled to receive suggestions and requests but I am both a busy University students and someone who jumps for hyperfixation to hyperfixation so keep in mind that it might take me a while to get around to it.

[b][size=2][u]Changes I will not be making:[/u][/size][/b]
- Adding other characters. The art by Baechu doesn't exist so they won't be added.
- Adding the option of just using the portraits. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3218/]this mod[/url] or add whatever sprites you want to be using manually yourself.

I tested the mod a bit but since there is quite a few assets and I edited the code a little haphazardly it's possible I missed a few things. I'll try to fix issues in a timely manner if you find one and inform me :)

I hope you all enjoy the mod!

You should absolutely check them out if you aren't already using them already anyway as they add so much to the game experience!

[b][u][size=4]Redistribution/Asset-use[/size][/u][/b]
Most of the assets in this mod are free-to-use but keep in mind a few things if you want to use anything in this mod for your own uploads!
Baechu has stated that they are alright with their work being modified and redistributed but it is very important to them that they are [b]credited as the original author[/b] and you aren't pretending otherwise! ([url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall?iframe_url_utf8=%2FArticleRead.nhn%253Fclubid%3D28468938%2526articleid%3D202909]트레이싱은 자제해주세요 : 네이버 카페 (naver.com)[/url])
The same goes for Poltergeister's assets (what the sprites are based on). They have given permission to use their assets but it is [b]important to credit them![/b] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister's Nexus Page[/url])
AkiraE has given [b]no such general permission[/b] so if it's the seasonal portrait edits you're looking to modify, you'll have to ask them for permission.

So as a rule of thumb, if it's the sprites you want to modify all you need to do is credit Poltergeister or me depending on what you use but for the Portraits you might need to obtain extra permission. I hope this clears things up! (But feel free to reach out if you have any concerns)
